claims: A 56s YouTube video by Jay Mayor dated Mar 15, 2026 explains the basics of artificial intelligence.
A 58s YouTube video by History of Simple Things dated Apr 7, 2026 explains how artificial intelligence works.
Weak/Narrow AI systems are designed for specific tasks.
Siri is a Weak/Narrow AI system.
ChatGPT is a Weak/Narrow AI system.
The current state of AI is Weak/Narrow AI.
Strong/General AI (AGI) does not exist yet.
Machine Learning (ML) is a subset of AI.
Machine Learning systems learn from data to improve performance without being explicitly programmed.
Deep Learning is a specialized form of ML using neural networks with many layers to analyze complex patterns.
Neural Networks are algorithms inspired by the human brain.
Neural Networks are used for recognizing patterns in data.
Natural Language Processing (NLP) understands and generates human language.
Computer Vision allows AI to interpret and analyze visual information from images and videos.
GPT-4 and Stable Diffusion are generative AI tools.
GPT-4 creates new text, images, and code.
Stable Diffusion creates new text, images, and code.
